children: West Coast Community Bancorp announced its Form 10 was declared effective and its common stock was approved to list on Nasdaq.
SEC declared the Company’s Registration Statement on Form 10 effective, enabling Nasdaq listing.
Common stock approved to trade on Nasdaq under ticker WCCB, expected to begin trading Sept. 16, 2026.
No new shares issued and no proceeds raised in connection with the uplisting.
Company furnished an investor presentation for use with investors and launched an enhanced IR website.
Uplisting intended to increase institutional engagement and broaden the shareholder base per management.
